races.name: QuinnBet Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
In-form NO MORE BOLERO has the least to prove and looks the percentage call in the opener. The main danger could be Juan Bermudez, who likes it here and may get a soft lead.

  1. NO MORE BOLERO
  2. JUAN BERMUDEZ
  3. ALL INN HAND

races.name: Paul Ferguson's Jumpers To Follow Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SQUARE D'ALBONI sets a fairly useful standard and may prove too strong for likely improver Arcturus Flame. Hurdling debutant Red Metal has to be respected in receipt of weight from that pair.

  1. SQUARE D'ALBONI (FR)
  2. ARCTURUS FLAME (IRE)
  3. RED METAL (FR)

races.name: Thanks To Our Raceday Team Past And Present Novices' Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
STELLARMASTERPIECE is thriving and can make it 4-4 at this course. Interesting handicap debutant Educator heads the dangers in a tricky race.

  1. STELLARMASTERPIECE (FR)
  2. EDUCATOR
  3. EMERALD TIME

races.name: Jodie Standing's Point-To-Point Recruits Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
PREMIER FANTASY has been knocking on the door under Rules and is awarded the tentative vote to gain a breakthrough win. Lermoos Legend seems sure to be thereabouts, while Two To Tango and Imperial Bede are on winning marks.

  1. PREMIER FANTASY (IRE)
  2. LERMOOS LEGEND
  3. TWO TO TANGO

races.name: Racing TV Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
A good chance for PESCATORIUS to resume winning ways off a 2 lb lower mark than when second to an improving novice here 6 weeks ago. Expert Analysis is an interesting chasing debutant for an in-form stable and could be the danger.

  1. PESCATORIUS (IRE)
  2. EXPERT ANALYSIS (IRE)
  3. LELANT (IRE)

races.name: Join Racing TV Now Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MON MISSEL is an interesting recruit from points and could be set to make a successful start under Rules. Turbogeist sets a fair standard but has been staying on strongly in bumpers at Worcester so this sharp track may not be in his favour. Persian Art is another appealing newcomer.

  1. MON MISSEL (FR)
  2. TURBOGEIST (IRE)
  3. PERSIAN ART (IRE)

races.name: White Swan Fish & Seafood Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
KOFFEE AND KALE suffered a troubled passage at Southwell last time and is worth another chance to build on his promising Wolverhampton second. Arnaz and Iconic Dawn both arrive after slightly below-par efforts but had been in good form prior and would also merit respect if able to bounce back.

  1. KOFFEE AND KALE
  2. ARNAZ
  3. ICONIC DAWN

races.name: Strawberry Fields Stud Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
CLAUDETTE showed plenty of encouragement when fifth at Ascot on debut, running green but staying on well once the penny dropped. Open to above-average improvement, she'll take some stopping. Awwjaan shaped as if she'd be better for her opening run and can also improve but the main danger is potentially Dawn Chorus, a very well bred newcomer for Charlie Appleby, who is enjoying another good year with his 2-y-o debutants.

  1. CLAUDETTE (FR)
  2. DAWN CHORUS
  3. AWWJAAN

races.name: SPP Digital 'Confined' EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ZHURI is bred in the purple and shaped well when fourth in a Newmarket novice on debut 16 days ago, moving powerfully before leaving the impression the run may well have been needed. She appeals as the type to take a significant step forward and confirm the promise of that effort here. Faithful, a well-bred newcomer from the William Haggas stable, is another to note, along with Lady Jemima.

  1. ZHURI
  2. FAITHFUL
  3. LADY JEMIMA

races.name: Origin Amenity Solutions Nursery
races.verdict:
GROUND FORCE has contested some pretty good races ahead of this switch to handicaps, and starting out at a low level a bigger performance could be forthcoming here. The drop back to 7f is a bit of a concern for Chaise Longue after her excellent staying-on second over 1m here 3 weeks ago but she clearly won't stay a maiden on that showing, while Santo is another potential improver now entering nurseries.

  1. GROUND FORCE
  2. CHAISE LONGUE
  3. SANTO

races.name: Price Bailey LLP Norwich Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Not a novice that will take much winning and potentially a good opening for the well-bred ENDLESS QUEST who makes a belated debut for her leading stable. A couple of last-place finishes probably don't do Evening Call justice and she's the obvious danger.

  1. ENDLESS QUEST (IRE)
  2. EVENING CALL
  3. MOONTUNE

races.name: Haven Seashore Holiday Park Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
BEACH POINT should be arriving here in search of a hat-trick, his failure to handle Epsom's camber proving costly last time and is taken to resume winning ways given he clearly remains at the top of his game. The reliable Lucky Hero and Accademia complete the shortlist.

  1. BEACH POINT (IRE)
  2. LUCKY HERO (IRE)
  3. ACCADEMIA

races.name: Moulton Racing Club Handicap
races.verdict:
ISLAND BEAR seemed well suited by combination of blinkers and this trip when getting off the mark at Leicester a fortnight ago and with a 3 lb nudge far from excessive, Dr Richard Newland's charge gets the verdict. Colonnade strikes as a potential improver now handicapping so he can give the selection most to do returned to 1m, with course-specialist Guest House and Media Legend taken to fight out third.

  1. ISLAND BEAR (IRE)
  2. COLONNADE (IRE)
  3. GUEST HOUSE (IRE)

races.name: Tips For Every Race At raceday-ready.com Nursery (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
WILBUR finished second in a strong course maiden in July and is weighted to go one better on his nursery debut. Likely improver Solar Swing shades the next-best vote ahead of Lion of God.

  1. WILBUR
  2. SOLAR SWING (IRE)
  3. LION OF GOD (IRE)

races.name: Download The Racecourse App Raceday Ready Nursery
races.verdict:
DREAMS GALORE will benefit from this return to 5f and Ollie Sangster's upwardly-mobile filly makes plenty of appeal in her quest to quickly resume winning ways. Sultan Darius should similarly benefit from this drop back in trip and can pose the biggest threat.

  1. DREAMS GALORE (IRE)
  2. SULTAN DARIUS (IRE)
  3. AMBER OCEAN

races.name: Download The Raceday Ready App Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
STARSHIP LILY was the subject of a misplaced hefty gamble on her debut and George Scott's filly should do better with that experience under her belt. Extended Credit can chase her home ahead of Iron Dome.

  1. STARSHIP LILY (IRE)
  2. EXTENDED CREDIT
  3. IRON DOME

races.name: Get The Inside Track With raceday-ready.com EBF Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
LADY BRANKSOME has shown enough to earn the vote in an ordinary-looking maiden. On The Queue Tee and Thai Baht appeal most of the remainder with experience, however, newcomer Fille Etoile could prove main danger if supported.

  1. LADY BRANKSOME (IRE)
  2. FILLE ETOILE (IRE)
  3. ON THE QUEUE TEE

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Handicap
races.verdict:
APEX STAR can gain compensation for his narrow miss over C&D last time. My Mate Kev and Torbados also appeal in a race that could set up for the closers.

  1. APEX STAR (IRE)
  2. MY MATE KEV
  3. TORBADOS

races.name: attheraces.com/marketmovers Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
THE DARK BARON has a good record at Wolverhampton and 4 lb rise for his recent C&D success may underestimate him given how well he finished off his race after being right up with the strong gallop. Canvas arrives after back-to-back seconds in big fields and is highly respected, with Faeberon also on the shortlist.

  1. THE DARK BARON (IRE)
  2. CANVAS
  3. FAEBERON (IRE)

races.name: attheraces.com/marketmovers Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
HAUTELUCE is 2-3 on all-weather and is lightly raced enough to think she can continue to progress now returned to this surface. The thriving Kaaranah is most feared, with Dovecote also meriting consideration upped in trip for his handicap bow.

  1. HAUTELUCE (FR)
  2. KAARANAH (IRE)
  3. DOVECOTE

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap
races.verdict:
GOLDFINDER stuck to his task really well when second at Kempton and on that evidence, he's up to winning a handicap at this level. Takeitorleaveit has stamina to prove for this far but is more reliable than most, while Caraway eases in class and should make her presence felt.

  1. GOLDFINDER
  2. TAKEITORLEAVEIT (IRE)
  3. CARAWAY

races.name: Race & Rest - Wolverhampton Holiday Inn Handicap
races.verdict:
POWDER MONKEY is going the right way now and can utilise his draw in stall 1 to complete the hat-trick. Alfa Whiteburd gave things a bold show from the front at Chester last time and is also respected alongside the reliable Tattie Bogle.

  1. POWDER MONKEY (IRE)
  2. ALFA WHITEBURD (IRE)
  3. TATTIE BOGLE

races.name: British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
NARRJOO matched the form of his promising debut second when going one place better in a small-field Ffos Las maiden in August and appealing as the type to improve further, not least now his stamina is tested further, he makes most appeal under a penalty. Beloved Country has shown plenty in a pair of well-contested events and he may well emerge as the chief threat.

  1. NARRJOO (IRE)
  2. BELOVED COUNTRY
  3. TOO DARN REGAL (IRE)

races.name: Constant Security Serving Yorkshire Racecourses Nursery
races.verdict:
FLORAL MAID cemented the positive start made to her career when again finding only one too good in a Beverley maiden 3 weeks ago, doing well having never been far away from the strong gallop. She remains open to improvement now stepping up in trip and earns the vote on nursery debut. Turnstile relished softer ground when scoring at Ayr's Western Meeting and rates a big danger. Social Spirit and Prosperity Angel complete the shortlist.

  1. FLORAL MAID (IRE)
  2. TURNSTILE
  3. SOCIAL SPIRIT

races.name: Autism In Racing Handicap
races.verdict:
ALPHA MAGIC has tumbled down the weights and shaped best after 8 weeks off when only just failing to reel in reopposing Fiscal Policy over C&D 18 days ago, the trouble he met arguably costing him. He gets the nod to confirm the promise of that run, with Fierce who shaped much better than the distance beaten suggests at Beverley, Fiscal Policy and Veydari others to consider.

  1. ALPHA MAGIC
  2. FIERCE (IRE)
  3. FISCAL POLICY (IRE)

races.name: Leslie Burton (Fisher) Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
START ME UP bounced back to his best returned to the scene of his 2 previous victories when runner-up at Chester last month and back sprinting from a handy draw, Richard Spencer's 3-y-o earns the vote. Andesite arrives in search of a hat-trick, so he rates as an obvious threat from just 2 lb higher, with The Good Biscuit and Papa Cocktail another couple worth considering, too.

  1. START ME UP
  2. ANDESITE
  3. THE GOOD BISCUIT

races.name: Leslie Burton (Fisher) Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
From her reduced mark, STORMY IMPACT was back on her game when runner-up at Hamilton 2 weeks ago. With the return to 6f in her favour and pretty fresh for this time of year, she could be the answer. Given his winning spree, it's surprising to see a tongue tie back on Classy Clarets but he has to be feared in his current mood, with Bell Shot also of interest.

  1. STORMY IMPACT
  2. CLASSY CLARETS (IRE)
  3. BELL SHOT (IRE)

races.name: Good Biscuit - Ponte Premiership Champion Handicap
races.verdict:
ALWAYS BLUE has far fewer miles on the clock than most and provided her ability can be channelled more efficiently than it was at Thirsk 3 weeks ago, Harriet Bethell's filly has every chance of going one better. On The Inlet shaped really well when fourth at Brighton last week and if cutting out his slow starts, he rates a big danger. Regal Desire and Galba can fight out minor honours.

  1. ALWAYS BLUE
  2. ON THE INLET (IRE)
  3. REGAL DESIRE (FR)

races.name: Always Trying Racing Syndicate Handicap
races.verdict:
FREE WORLD has fewer miles on the clock than most and with his latest effort best overlooked on account of the ground, he's selected to quickly bounce back. Noble Grace looked in need of an even greater emphasis on stamina over 1¾m at Bath recently and is next best, ahead of Simiyann.

  1. FREE WORLD
  2. NOBLE GRACE (IRE)
  3. SIMIYANN (IRE)

races.name: Constant Security Services Handicap
races.verdict:
JOJO RABBIT bolted up at Catterick last week and wisely turned out under a 4-lb penalty, he looks a major player once more with the plum draw to work from. Fellow last-time-out winner Go Victor is a danger, whilst Knicks is also worthy of a second look from a career-low mark. Beerwah and Speeding Bullet complete the dangers in a competitive finale.

  1. JOJO RABBIT
  2. GO VICTOR (IRE)
  3. KNICKS (IRE)

races.name: Unibet More Extra Place Races EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
DARK SUPREMACY exceeded expectations when fourth on debut at Sandown 3 weeks ago and with the fifth-place finisher that day winning recently, the form of that race looks solid. Expected to build on that, he could be the answer, for all there are several newcomers for leading yards in opposition, Spartan and Zabeel Express of particular interest.

  1. DARK SUPREMACY (IRE)
  2. SPARTAN
  3. ZABEEL EXPRESS (IRE)

races.name: Unibet Supports Safer Gambling Handicap
races.verdict:
BOFA BEACH matched the very pick of her Irish form when runner-up over C&D 12 days ago (yard saddled the first 3) and from a handy draw, she makes plenty of appeal. Footstepinthewoods and Berkshire Boom look the chief threats.

  1. BOFA BEACH
  2. FOOTSTEPINTHEWOODS (IRE)
  3. BERKSHIRE BOOM (IRE)

races.name: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
NOBLE JOURNEY has a year-long absence to overcome but he's in expert hands and it may well be telling that William Buick rides him in preference to the standard-setting stablemate Pursuit of Love. Allaire will relish this trip and is the obvious other contender.

  1. NOBLE JOURNEY
  2. PURSUIT OF LOVE
  3. ALLAIRE

races.name: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Handicap
races.verdict:
EXTRATERRESTRIAL and Sax Avoidance dominated a C&D handicap 3 weeks ago and they may well come to the fore again, with the former tentatively selected to reverse the placings. Of the rest, Sea Brave is a potential improver on handicap debut up in distance.

  1. EXTRATERRESTRIAL (IRE)
  2. SAX AVOIDANCE (IRE)
  3. SEA BRAVE (IRE)

races.name: Try Unibet's New Smartview Racecards Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
MOVING FORCE has returned to form on all-weather and is taken to go one better than when second over C&D in May, having backed up that effort at Southwell last month. Em Four is a C&D winner who should bounce back from his latest Goodwood run where he received a hefty knock at the start, whilst Goldwork is better than he showed last time and is one to be interested in from a falling mark.

  1. MOVING FORCE (IRE)
  2. EM FOUR
  3. GOLDWORK

races.name: Try Unibet's New Smartview Racecards Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
A trappy sprint in which preference is for BUCCABAY, who had been holding his form well prior to his latest Newmarket effort and Eve Johnson Houghton's 6-y-o can bounce back quickly to open his 2026 account. Tyger Bay caused a 33/1 shock at Yarmouth last month and with 5 C&D wins to his name, he's put forward as the main threat. Mesaafi may prove best of the rest.

  1. BUCCABAY (IRE)
  2. TYGER BAY
  3. MESAAFI

races.name: Set Your Limits With Unibet Handicap
races.verdict:
KONDRATIEV WAVE gets the vote making a return to all-weather. Ararat has the benefit of the inside stall and can do better this time, while Portman Blue can't be ruled out.

  1. KONDRATIEV WAVE (IRE)
  2. ARARAT (IRE)
  3. PORTMAN BLUE

races.name: Racing TV Handicap
races.verdict:
This looks a good opportunity for the penalised RIDGER to quickly double his tally. Creciente and Poetic Grace make most appeal to chase him home.

  1. RIDGER (IRE)
  2. CRECIENTE
  3. POETIC GRACE (IRE)

races.name: Bet 20 Pound Get 20 Pound With Unibet Handicap
races.verdict:
SUPER HIT went close here recently and can go one better at the expense of the consistent Currumbin. Chesneys Charm and Mrembo are others to consider.

  1. SUPER HIT (FR)
  2. CURRUMBIN (IRE)
  3. CHESNEYS CHARM

races.name: Connolly's RED MILLS Irish EBF Auction & Median Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
MYLUCKYMAKER has finished runner-up 4 times in bumpers and should make her mark over hurdles. This could be a good opening for her first time up in this sphere. Griffaldo is an interesting newcomer, while Lilannbee should be bang there if keeping the mistakes down.

  1. MYLUCKYMAKER (IRE)
  2. GRIFFALDO (IRE)
  3. LILANNBEE

races.name: Sign Up To GavinLynchRacing.com (C & G) Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
STATE PENSION kept his quirks in check when third on hurdles debut at Navan 16 days ago and will take plenty of beating if able to build on that performance. Midtown Manhattan was too free at Ballinrobe in May but should be helped by the drop in trip and looks the main danger, with Crystal Mariner and Farney Bridge also respected.

  1. STATE PENSION (IRE)
  2. MIDTOWN MANHATTAN (IRE)
  3. CRYSTAL MARINER (IRE)

races.name: Racing Again October 10th Mares Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
SEA OF DOUBT arrives on the back of a chase win and, reunited with a conditional who knows her well, is taken to follow up in a race lacking depth. Whispering Willow has posted 2 good efforts recently and rates the main danger, while Classy Cc and Victoria Kesia can also be involved if running up to their best.

  1. SEA OF DOUBT (IRE)
  2. WHISPERING WILLOW (IRE)
  3. CLASSY CC (IRE)

races.name: Adare Manor Opportunity Mares Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
LA MULETA shaped with encouragement when third at Kilbeggan 32 days ago and, with improvement likely, looks the one to beat. Everyday Life hasn’t set the world alight but has been contesting stronger maidens and rates the main danger, while An Lachin Beag is respected back over hurdles.

  1. LA MULETA (FR)
  2. EVERYDAY LIFE (IRE)
  3. AN LACHIN BEAG (IRE)

races.name: Winter Festival Tickets On Sale Now Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
REBEL REBA has a stamina-laden pedigree, represents a top yard and is taken to build on her point success now hurdling. Well Bud was placed twice in bumpers and could prove the main danger, with the booking of Jack Kennedy catching the eye, while Airds Moss is also respected.

  1. REBEL REBA (IRE)
  2. WELL BUD (IRE)
  3. AIRDS MOSS (IRE)

races.name: Winter Festival November 28th & 29th Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
BROKEN ICE shaped well when runner-up at Perth 11 days ago and is taken to go one better. Diamond Tipp has only one standout effort for her current yard but is interesting upped to 3m and looks the main danger, while the well-treated Dinoland and Mickey Cohen are also respected.

  1. BROKEN ICE (IRE)
  2. DIAMOND TIPP (IRE)
  3. DINOLAND (FR)

races.name: Fairyhouse Racecourse Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
ITSAWORKINMANIAM is given another chance to build on an eye-catching handicap debut, and he may well get off the mark in first-time cheekpieces. Las Brisas Boy and Gypsy Poet both hold solid claims, while Magic Hands Noel and Vision De Maine are potential improvers, the latter particularly interesting if supported.

  1. ITSAWORKINMANIAM (IRE)
  2. LAS BRISAS BOY (IRE)
  3. GYPSY POET (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
races.verdict:
WECOULDAVEHADITALL sets the standard following a much better effort at Naas last time. She's preferred to Heart Of You, who has scope to improve up in trip for new connections. Lake Lugano is another who could feature if blinkers have the desired effect.

  1. WECOULDAVEHADITALL (IRE)
  2. HEART OF YOU (IRE)
  3. LAKE LUGANO (IRE)

races.name: Gleneagle Killarney Median Auction Maiden
races.verdict:
GLIONDAR is worth another chance to confirm his debut promise and could well make it third time lucky. Karrygrant is likely to be knocking on the door again, with Fleur de Provence expected to be firmly in the mix, too.

  1. GLIONDAR (FR)
  2. KARRYGRANT (IRE)
  3. FLEUR DE PROVENCE (IRE)

races.name: Carry Out Off-Licence Handicap
races.verdict:
CLADACH has been progressing with consecutive runner-up efforts and would have gone very close at Gowran 16 days ago had a clear run appeared sooner. He's up 6 lb but can go one better in first-time cheekpieces. Closely is well bred and makes her handicap debut from a lowly mark, while Sherekiya has gradually been getting the hang of things, and deserves another chance following a disappointing run last time.

  1. CLADACH (IRE)
  2. CLOSELY (IRE)
  3. SHEREKIYA (IRE)

races.name: Killarney Student Raceday Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
BIG BILL is unexposed and won last week in a manner that suggests he'll be able to prove competitive under a penalty here. The consistent Nibras Rainbow should be on the premises again, while Concaire is another to consider.

  1. BIG BILL (FR)
  2. NIBRAS RAINBOW (IRE)
  3. CONCAIRE (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Navigation Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
SHAIHAAN is eased in grade here and with conditions likely to suit, he gets the verdict in a trappy listed event. Caught U Sleeping is a reliable filly and will benefit from the step back up in trip, so is also shortlisted alongside likely improver Latin America.

  1. SHAIHAAN (IRE)
  2. CAUGHT U SLEEPING (IRE)
  3. LATIN AMERICA (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
The well-bred TOGETHER NOW could have a lot more to come having caught the eye in a big way on her recent return at the Curragh and is hard to get away from with this longer trip sure to suit. Shanala is the danger.

  1. TOGETHER NOW (USA)
  2. SHANALA (IRE)
  3. HEY STELLA (IRE)

races.name: Killarney Grand Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
There could be more to come from BELIEVE BELIEVE now that he's up and running and he can follow up his Punchestown success with this longer trip likely to be in his favour. Shay's Dream and Wie Wunderbar are a couple of the likely dangers in a competitive handicap for the grade.

  1. BELIEVE BELIEVE (IRE)
  2. SHAY'S DREAM (IRE)
  3. WIE WUNDERBAR

races.name: Spin Southwest Maiden
races.verdict:
JOE COOL ran to a fairly useful level when finishing runner-up in a couple of Flat maidens back in the spring and having found things happening too quickly over 7f at Laytown last month, Noel Meade's 4-y-o is put forward as the answer sporting first-time headgear. Blue Nasturtium hasn't gone on from a promising debut but she's feared most, with Ballybawn Belter seemingly best of the rest.

  1. JOE COOL (IRE)
  2. BLUE NASTURTIUM (IRE)
  3. BALLYBAWN BELTER (IRE)

races.name: Prix Du Mondial Du Lion - Prix Des Oeillets Stakes
Prix De La Place Du Petit Pont - Monte
Prix Du Pont Des Arts - Attele
Prix Du Jardin Du Luxembourg - Monte
Prix De La Porte De Chatillon - Attele
